title: Perfect way to explore history
text: Thanks again, Matt! We had a wonderful time exploring the old neighborhoods with you.  We learned a lot about Barcelona,​from past centuries to today. Thank you for sharing all your knowledge with us.
author: fleur0s

title: Fabulous Barcelona Old Town Gothic Quarter Tour
text: Arrrrrrmando was a great guide and did a great job giving a very interesting history of the city, its evolution and the culture. From the Roman's to Picasso to food and drinks he gave a great overview. I've been back already to several spots he pointed out on our trip through the maze known as the Gothic Quarter.
author: garybY5729CO

title: Great tour
text: Matt was a great guide and his passion for Barcelona and its history shone through in all the stories and info he shared. Being a very small group he lead us on an ‘Off the beaten track’ walk and showed us many of the less travelled streets and showed us little details and locals recommendations as well as the iconic places you would expect.
author: E2323SPmoniquec

title: Gothic quarter tour
text: Luke was an amazing tour guide. Fortunately it was just my parents and I who booked on the day we toured. Luke has so much knowledge of Barcelona and its history. The symbolism and all the historical events that happened around the Gothic quarter were amazing to hear about. Luke also pointed out food and coffee recs that did not disappoint! I’m glad I booked this tour for my parents and I. I highly recommend this tour!
author: Marvincayanan

title: Great overview of city of Barcelona
text: Matt was very knowledgable, funny, and helpful with restaurant and sightseeing suggestions.
author: TravelingMawMaw

title: Great Barcelona walking tour
text: Excellent tour. Matt is so knowledgeable and his love for Barcelona shows. He shared so much of the rich history of the city and gave excellent recommendations for places to eat and drink. I highly recommend Matt and Jana!
author: Kimzimm

title: Fantastic Barcelona Walking Tour
text: Jana was very knowledgeable and entertaining - the very best walking tour I have experienced. Barcelona is a fascinating and wonderful city with old streets hundreds if not thousands of years old. Jana helped us use our imagination and bring ancient history back to life. She enlightened us on local customs and Catalan culture.
author: funtraveler354

title: Best ever! Fantastic! Interesting, captivating. Left us wanting more!
text: Matt was an outstanding tour guide! We were in Barcelona on a mother /son trip and Matt provided us with our very first Airbnb experience which was a 5 star experience all the way! Matt set the bar high for all other tours that we took!  This was an outstanding welcome  to our time in Barcelona! Matt was personable, interesting, experienced, knowledgeable and fun! He genuinely loves Barcelona and showed her off very well! We learned so much from Matt in the most entertaining way! title: Introduction to Gothic Quarter Walking Tour
text: This tour is a great way to introduce yourself to the history of Barcelona and the Gothic Quarter! Matt did a good job job of bringing the history and culture of the last 2000 years together to help understand how Barcelona became the city it is today. Highly recommended tour! Also appreciated the personal recommendations for local restaurants and coffee in the area. We took advantage of what Matt provided us!
